title: PF2e Patchwork
description: Small, independently configurable quality-of-life features for Pathfinder 2e, including GM target indicator suppression, scene-based day/night playlists, client pause-banner positioning, compact chat toolbar controls, GM playlist curation, optional About Face animation improvements, Silent GM Initiative, scoped spellcasting information icons and spellbook UI locking, GM-confirmed session Hero Point resets, and native token movement history controls.
